clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Gnomeregan's surface entrances in Dun Morogh, the Train Depot lies overrun by leper gnomes and troggs. Once a center of gnomish rail travel, it now stands in ruin.

The Train Depot lies below the grand elevator from Dun Morogh, where rail lines once carried gnomes through Gnomeregan. Its platforms and tracks now lie in ruin. The radiation that swept through the city changed the workers who remained into crazed leper gnomes, and troggs from below have overrun the rails. You must cross the depot to reach deeper parts of the city, including Clockwerk Run, the Loading Room, and the inner engineering facilities.
